name: base_utils
description: Base utility module providing common helper types, custom functions, custom types, Facter facts, Bolt tasks and plans with cross-module function sharing, MOTD management, and OS-specific package installation.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Full application stack profile orchestrating Python FastAPI/Uvicorn application deployment with Git repository cloning, virtualenv management, PostgreSQL database provisioning, systemd service configuration, and Prometheus monitoring integration.

name: profile_haproxy
description: HAProxy load balancer profile with multi-backend support, dynamic PuppetDB node discovery, SSL/TLS termination, stats page with authentication, and firewall management.

name: profile_postgresql
description: PostgreSQL installation profile with PGDG repository configuration, version pinning, OS-specific package management, and service lifecycle management.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Redis cluster profile using puppet-redis module with PuppetDB node discovery for cluster member identification, custom Facter fact for node role detection, and AOF persistence configuration.

name: profile
description: Thin wrapper profiles providing composition layer between roles and feature modules, delegating to profile_app_stack, profile_haproxy, and profile_redis_cluster modules with environment fact passing.

name: role
description: Role definitions implementing the roles-and-profiles pattern for app_server, app_stack, haproxy, and redis_cluster with Linux kernel detection and exec path defaults.

name: puppetdb_query_stub
description: Stub implementation of PuppetDB query function for testing/development environments without PuppetDB, providing mock puppetdb_query function that returns empty arrays.
